summary: Operator site (GoDaddy, hosts Monica and Ben Fuller): 52 campsites (W/E + full hookup + tent), showers/laundry/store, no dump station, season Memorial Day weekend-Oct 1, phone-only reservations with a 2-night non-refundable deposit, walk-ins if open, and a standing THREE-NIGHT MINIMUM. Cleared derived 50 A, 45 sites, 45 ft (no operator source). No rates posted; price rests on RV Life $$. Presence: site + phone 970-944-2622 match, Google Maps 4.4/107. No gateway within 40 km, no family stays. Road: the site says nothing about CR-30 conditions or 4WD.
flags: DROP candidate (standing minimum): the operator FAQ says 'Does Castle Lakes have a nightly minimum? We do have a three night minimum.' — a 3-night minimum on every stay, not limited to weekends or holidays (https://castlelakescampground.com/faq). Under the 2026-10-19 standing-minimum rule this park may be dropped.
